description: This file defines CMake functions to convert JSON strings into CMake-compatible strings, handling escape sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a CMake string, handling escape sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a reference to a JSON string, by dereferencing and applying json_string_to_cmake.
